evidence.title: Hyperiux Vault — 54 React Components, Preview & Copy | 21st

name: Hyperiux Vault
summary: Author page on 21st for Hyperiux Vault: 54 free React and Next.js interaction-effect components, copyable or installed via the shadcn CLI.
description: Hyperiux Vault is a source-first library of polished React and Next.js interaction effects, animations, transitions and microinteractions, ready to copy, customize and ship. The 21st author page lists 54 components — a 50-component free library (hyperiux-vault) with animated text, carousels, cursors, buttons, navigation and transitions — plus pro components and templates from the same studio.
contains: components include Animated Border Beam, Arc Flow Carousel, Elevate Navbar and Typing Text
free components plus pro components and templates
copy the TSX or install with the shadcn CLI
